title: Cubic solver work count
statement: For a finite coordinate type with decidable equality and an encoding, and a finite list of linear equations over $\mathbb{F}_2$, define the solver's work count as the elimination procedure's work plus the number of its pivots multiplied by one more than the number of coordinates.
hypotheses_covered: Equality on the coordinate type is decidable
The input is a finite list of linear equations
